skills.summary: Runs axe-core as the automated baseline, walks the page with the Tab key in headless Chromium, and reports keyboard traps, mouse-only controls, invisible focus and positive tabindex with steps and whether the scan missed them.
triggers: Keyboard accessibility audit of a page or staging build
Tab order or focus trap check
boundaries: Forward Tab from page start only
method: Tab to an end sentinel, then Escape and retry
stopping_conditions: Exit 0 when the walk reaches the end with no blocking finding
skills.output_contract: One JSON object: ok, adapter versions, automated_scan, tab_stops, reached_end, findings (rule, wcag, steps, expected, observed, flagged_by_automated_scan), missed_by_automated_scan, limits.
failure_states: No browser adapter: blocked with manual steps

skills.summary: Catches placeholder, plural, untranslated-string, length-budget and RTL layout defects in gettext catalogs, page templates and CSS; linguistic review always stays a required human step.
triggers: Check translations or locale catalogs before release
boundaries: Never approves translation meaning, tone or register
inputs: One or more PO catalogs, each named <locale>.po or passed as LOCALE=PATH, with a Language header that must agree
method: Compare each catalog with the POT
Apply RTL template and CSS rules when an RTL locale is checked

skills.output_contract: One JSON object: ok, locales with findings, template_findings, linguistic_review (always required, owner human:language-reviewer), limits.
failure_states: PO syntax error: exit 2 with file and line
Unknown language: non-blocking finding, not a guess

skills.summary: Gates each agency engagement transition on evidence: brief qualification and margin, stage evidence bound to the factory-rig contract, support runbook completeness, and a verified handoff.v1 recorded through the company-fleets ledger.
triggers: Scope or price a client brief
Support or hosting handoff for a client site
boundaries: Not a tracker or scheduler; the PM layer and factory-rig own those
inputs: Scoped brief, plus the margin policy and rate card the contract owner pinned in the owner log
Stage ledger and contract, plus the stage acceptances and human roster in the owner log
Worker update and handoff id; owner fields and input labels come from the owner log
prerequisites: company-fleets and factory-rig beside this skill for brief, stages and handoff (the owner log lives in company-fleets)
method: brief: qualification, acceptance evidence, change control and margin against owner-pinned policy and rates
stages: order, evidence hashes, producer is not acceptor, scope hash, every settled stage accepted in the owner log
handoff: read the owner's open and intake records, scan, guarded update, submit, gate
skills.output_contract: One JSON object with ok, findings and limits, plus margin, current_stage, sections_required or handoff status, paths, refused_fields and untrusted_findings.
failure_states: Scope changed after the contract: return through the PM contract
Protected field in a worker update: refused and listed
Client B input or external destination for confidential data: invalid
A value not in the owner log (worker-written acceptance, intake, policy or label): refused by name

references.title: Company Agent Fleets task prompt, sections 4 and 12
